mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.order_id, a.after_sale_no, a.order_no, a.after_sale_type, a.status, a.goods_status, a.reason, a.remark, a.images, a.merchant_remark, a.refund_amount, a.refund_no, a.refund_channel, a.is_deleted, a.created_at, a.updated_at, o.user_id, o.consignee, o.phone, o.region, o.detail_address, o.pay_type, o.pay_at, o.pay_amount, o.order_status, o.courier, o.tracking_number FROM after_sales a LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sales (order_id, order_no, after_sale_no, after_sale_type, status, goods_status, reason, remark, images, merchant_remark, refund_amount, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{afterSaleNo}, #{afterSaleType}, #{status}, #{goodsStatus}, #{reason}, #{remark}, #{images}, #{merchantRemark}, #{refundAmount}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: WHERE a.order_id = #{orderId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sales SET refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_no = #{refundNo}, refund_channel = #{refundChannel}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM after_sales a JOIN after_sale_items i ON i.after_sale_id = a.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status IN ('reviewing', 'returning', 'refunding', 'exchanging') AND i.order_item_id = #{orderItemId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM after_sales a WHERE a.order_id = #{orderId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status IN ('reviewing', 'returning', 'refunding', 'exchanging')
